title: [Minaret, Refuge]
description: Tiles on the walls, ceiling, and floor of this circular room form incredibly intricate geometric patterns which center on the large statue of a blood eagle in the middle of the room.  A wide arch flanked by a pair of brass braziers leads out onto a balcony.  Against the far wall, an oak-framed mirror reflects the fire from the braziers.

steps.for: The mirror won't turn any farther to the right|You turn the oak-framed mirror slightly to the right

steps.when: capture_match:turn=The mirror won't turn any farther to the right

steps.for: from the base of the statue onto the center of the statue|You tilt the oak-framed mirror up until it flips around|You tilt the oak-framed mirror up slightly

steps.when: capture_match:tilt=from the base of the statue onto the center of the statue

then.for: from the base of the statue onto the center of the statue|You turn the oak-framed mirror slightly to the left|The mirror won't turn any farther to the left

then.when: capture_match:left=from the base of the statue onto the center of the statue
capture_match:left=The mirror won't turn any farther to the left
